parameters.query:
SELECT 
  (CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) AS has_record_today,
  a.id AS attendance_id,
  a.date::TEXT AS attendance_date,
  a.check_in,
  a.check_out,
  a.status,
  a.status_label,
  a.expected_checkout_time,
  a.late_allowance_used,
  a.total_duration_minutes,
  a.work_duration_minutes,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE late_allowance_used IS NOT NULL AND late_allowance_used > 0)
    FROM attendances
    WHERE employee_id = '{{ $json.employeeId }}'
      AND TO_CHAR(date, 'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
      AND date < CURRENT_DATE
  ), 0) AS monthly_lates_used,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT available FROM leave_balances 
    WHERE employee_id = '{{ $json.employeeId }}' AND leave_type = 'HALF_DAY' AND year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT 
    LIMIT 1
  ), 0) AS half_day_available,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT available FROM leave_balances 
    WHERE employee_id = '{{ $json.employeeId }}' AND leave_type = 'CASUAL' AND year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT 
    LIMIT 1
  ), 0) AS casual_available
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN attendances a 
  ON a.employee_id = '{{ $json.employeeId }}' 
 AND a.date = CURRENT_DATE
LIMIT 1;

={{ $json.sqlQuery }}

WITH att AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    employee_id,
    date::TEXT,
    check_in,
    check_out,
    status,
    status_label,
    expected_checkout_time AS expected_check_out_time,
    work_duration_minutes,
    total_duration_minutes,
    lunch_duration_minutes,
    late_allowance_used,
    is_half_day_case,
    notes
  FROM attendances
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.attendanceId }}'
  LIMIT 1
),
punches AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', id,
    'type', type,
    'timestamp', timestamp,
    'timeString', time_string,
    'location', location,
    'note', note
  ) ORDER BY timestamp ASC), '[]'::json) AS punch_list
  FROM attendance_punches
  WHERE attendance_id = '{{ $json.attendanceId }}'
)
SELECT 
  row_to_json(att.*) AS record,
  (SELECT punch_list FROM punches) AS punches
FROM att;
